description: A 3D model (mesh) placed on the globe at a geographic position with configurable scale and rotation. Globe-only (not drawn on the 2D map).

supportedData.label: 3D mesh model
supportedData.description: A textured 3D mesh placed on the globe at a lng/lat position with configurable scale and rotation. Rendered by the LithoSphere globe engine only.
supportedData.procurement: Export a COLLADA (.dae) or OBJ (.obj) mesh with its textures alongside.
